title: 카톡 원문과 실시간 주문·분배 이력의 읽기 전용 대조

criteria.pasteMatchedEvidence: Single-message paste analysis may project fully matched current customer/product names, quantity, unit and action into read-only evidence matching. Preserve original identity, exact timestamp and year/week markers, including 차 suffix. Incomplete mappings fall back to original text. Display that evidence is based on current analysis, not proof that the raw message was fully interpreted. No ERP or alias writes.
criteria.requestBalance: Read-only comparison of each unambiguous signed request and its unique ShipmentHistory change. Order history is never distribution evidence. All candidates, including partial changes, compete for event claims. A cancel/add transfer may have zero net stock effect without implying completion. Missing or competing evidence stays visible.
criteria.currentBalance: One exact OrderYear+OrderWeek+ProdKey ProductStock snapshot is a stored value, not historical proof or predicted availability. Missing/duplicate/non-finite snapshot is null, actual zero is valid. Current ViewShipment quantity is grouped without ShipmentDate multiplication. Never subtract requests again or mutate stock.
criteria.scope: One exact OrderYear and full OrderWeek with a maximum seven-day ChangeDtm range and one global batch of at most 200 messages; no combined-week inference. All messages in the batch compete for the same history events. Read-only SQL may run for up to 25 seconds and the browser waits up to 30 seconds so a slow ERP read is not mislabeled as no evidence.
criteria.orderHistory: Only OrderHistory.ColumName=주문수량 with non-no-op finite BeforeValue/AfterValue is order evidence; BeforeValue is original order and AfterValue is OrderDetail.OutQuantity, never 미발주수량.
criteria.matching: Exact catalog name, a unique exact parenthetical customer label, or saved alias, exact identity, explicit unit conversion, and source-time-before-event are required for a confirmed match. Parenthetical matching accepts ASCII/full-width parentheses but never a loose substring. When the product has no explicit conversion factor, one unique same-number and same-direction history event may be displayed only as UNIT_HISTORY_CANDIDATE with the input and ERP units visible. When an exact product alias is absent but the exact customer has exactly one later ShipmentHistory event with the requested number and direction, it may be displayed only as PRODUCT_HISTORY_CANDIDATE. Neither candidate status claims application. Ambiguous, approximate, date-only, deleted, complex, multi-date, competing, or truncated evidence never claims application.
criteria.advisory: POST is read-only and returns erpAction NONE; every status is evidence only.

crossYearFixture.description: A prior-year same-week event does not pair with the selected year.

dnspyEvidence.note: Main decompile review confirms FormOrderAdd records 주문수량 as BeforeValue original order and AfterValue OrderDetail.OutQuantity; 미발주수량 remains a separate history column.
